scope: PHerc0139 w016 exposed known-domain validation diagnostic; retained prediction and public ink/supervision/validation mask crop; no inference or target work
evaluation_population: validation > 0 only; require no overlap with supervision; truth = ink > 0
geometry_only_score: Euclidean distance in pixels from each validation pixel to the nearest pixel outside the validation mask (scipy.ndimage.distance_transform_edt); this is annotation/evaluation-mask geometry, not CT or physical papyrus geometry
stratum_refusal: Report every stratum. Refuse AUC if fewer than 2000 pixels or either label class absent. Pool evaluable within-stratum AUC by positive-negative pair count; report omitted pixels and pairs.
model_metric: Tie-aware ROC AUC of uint8 scores, and average precision on the exact original validation population; do not add or subtract AUCs as components.
null: 199 random within-spatial-block label permutations; blocks are fixed 64x64 crop pixels anchored at crop origin, seed 20260930; preserve each block's label count and scored support; report full null quantiles and Monte Carlo upper-tail p=(1+null>=observed)/(200)
uncertainty: 512 spatial-block bootstrap replicates, sampling occupied 64x64 blocks with replacement using seed 20260930; sum per-block positive/negative score histograms; percentile 2.5-97.5 ROC AUC; report degenerate replicates.
source_selection: No score, bin, block-size or transformation selected using validation labels. Stop on prediction, chunk, shape, crop or label-identity mismatch.
interpretation_limit: Diagnostic of one known-domain exposed validation. Evaluation-mask distance and local label shuffle cannot prove CT-specific ink signal or cross-scroll transfer. A statistically surprising association is not a discovery.
